blocks.text: CATIGBIAN, Bohol — The municipal government of Catigbian is strengthening its water security and agricultural support measures in preparation for El Niño that could prolong dry conditions and threaten farms and community water supplies. Mayor Benjie Oliva said the local government has been identifying potential watershed areas and alternative water sources since April, including rivers and streams that could supply the proposed Catigbian Water Treatment Plant. They inspected the Upper Loboc River and Upper Abatan River, including a river near the Bohol Area Command in Barangay Maitum and an area about three kilometers from Makapiko Bridge in Barangay Mahayag Norte.
